events.description: A man (Tom Cruise) is shown inside a vehicle during violent motion: he is thrown against the interior, eyes wide, mouth open in shock, with visible motion blur and disorientation across frames f0–f4, indicating rapid deceleration or rollover consistent with a crash.

An overturned black SUV rests on its roof on a debris-covered surface; dust is still settling, and a heavy platform/barrier is visible beneath it, confirming a high-impact crash and rollover. Frames f12–f15 show the aftermath with clear vehicle damage and environmental destruction.
A black SUV is shown overturned on a debris-strewn road, with visible damage and dust being kicked up as it settles; the vehicle appears to have just crashed and rolled.

A massive explosion erupts behind a running man, violently propelling a car into the air and sending fire and debris outward; the blast is sudden and intense, characteristic of an explosion rather than sustained fire.
A car is violently launched into the air by the explosion, indicating a secondary collision or impact event triggered by the blast.
A large, sudden explosion erupts behind the man and the overturned SUV, propelling the vehicle into the air with intense fireball and debris.
An SUV is shown overturned and on fire on a highway; the man emerges from under it, indicating a recent crash and rollover event.
The same SUV is violently launched into the air by the explosion, rotating mid-air before beginning to descend—this constitutes a secondary impact/collision event due to the blast force.
A large, sudden fireball erupts from a vehicle mid-air, with debris and intense flames expanding rapidly; the explosion is at its peak intensity between frames f0–f4.
A vehicle is seen airborne and flipping (f0–f4), then impacts and burns on the ground (f7–f10); the sequence shows a high-impact crash culminating in sustained fire and structural destruction.
A vehicle is overturned and engulfed in flames, indicating a recent high-impact crash; debris is scattered around the wreckage.
Intense fireball and rapid smoke plume from the vehicle at the start of the sequence suggest a secondary explosion (e.g., fuel tank ignition) immediately following the crash.
